build_tourist_language_model: build a TouristLanguage model with GRU encoders for actions and observations to generate utterances
build_guide_language_model: build a GuideLanguage model with bidirectional LSTM encoder and MASC attention for landmark prediction
run_tourist_forward_pass: run the TouristLanguage forward pass with beam search decoding strategy on a batch
run_guide_forward_pass: run the GuideLanguage forward pass to compute landmark probabilities and supervised loss
save_load_tourist_model: save and load a TouristLanguage model state dict to and from disk
